1399-11-25 is 1399-11-25.  
124 days before:  
1399 has 365 days (non-leap in Jalali? Context says Gregorian, so 1399 is a year, treat as Gregorian).  
1399 is not a leap year (divisible by 4? 1399 mod 4 = 3, not leap).  
From 11-25 back:  
October has 31 days, September 30, August 31, July 31, June 30, May 31, April 30, March 31, February 28, January 31.  
Count backward:  
Nov 25 → Oct 25 is 31 days earlier (Oct 25 to Nov 25 = 31 days).  
124 total: 31 days to Oct 25 leaves 93 days.  
Oct 25 → Sep 25 is 30 days earlier → 63 left.  
Sep 25 → Aug 25 is 31 days earlier → 32 left.  
Aug 25 → Jul 25 is 31 days earlier → 1 left.  
Jul 25 → Jul 24 is 1 day earlier → 0 left.  

So date is 1399-07-24.
